title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 22 (Execution of bills of exchange, etc.)

content.overview: A bill of exchange, hundi or promissory note is deemed to have been made, accepted, drawn or endorsed on behalf of the company if made, accepted, drawn or endorsed in the name of, or on behalf or on account of, the company by any person acting under its authority, express or implied.
content.glance: Company bills/notes bind if made under company authority.
content.study: Section 22 deems a bill of exchange, hundi or promissory note to have been made, accepted, drawn or endorsed on behalf of the company if done in the name of, or on behalf or on account of, the company by any person acting under its authority, express or implied.

sections.heading: Deemed company instrument
sections.body: Bill, hundi or promissory note made under company authority binds as company instrument.

provisions.title: Execution of bills of exchange, etc.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should Section 22 be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Identify the instrument. II. Test whether it was made under company authority. III. Conclude.
